title: Algebraic restriction composition identity
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a sign-valued Boolean function, let $\\delta_1,\\delta_2\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $k\\in\\mathbb N$. The switching-failure probability of $f$ at parameter $\\delta_1\\delta_2$ and threshold $k$ equals the average over first restrictions at parameter $\\delta_1$ of the switching-failure probabilities at parameter $\\delta_2$ and threshold $k$ for the corresponding functions on the free coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube with sign-valued output
Real parameters $\\delta_1,\\delta_2$ with no bounds assumed
